Ascension (Free for base game - Play Store

Great deck-builder game. It's a deck-builder, not a CCG, so all the cards are available to you. 2-4 players start each game with the same decks, and take turns playing those cards to get resources, then using those resources to purchase/defeat cards from the center. Play continues until the point pool is depleted, at which point players tally up their score, plus the value of cards in their deck. Takes about 5-10 minutes to play through the tutorial, and the base game is free, with additional sets of cards costing around $3. You can only participate in games that are using decks that you own, so all players are always on equal footing. Can play locally with one device, or online(Compatible with iOS users), with a 10 minute to 28 day game clock.

Made by a couple of Magic: The Gathering pros, the physical version of the game was successfully Kickstarted, and the company has since Kickstarted and released Star Realms, and Kickstarted a third card game(But Ascension still gets support, the latest set released a couple of months ago!).
